Jordan / Marissa — reviewed ACME's redlines and the subprocessors list. High level guidance below (draft language included for the DPA response):

1) Data transfer mechanism (SCCs): we should accept EU SCCs + our SCC appendix (SCC_Appendix_Draft.docx). The appendix documents the controller/processor roles and technical measures and is our standard. If ACME insists on UK Addendum only for UK data, we can append it, but prefer single SCC path for global consistency. Suggested line: "The parties shall execute the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, incorporated by reference, and the Processor's SCC Appendix."

2) Subprocessor notice period: 30 days is our default to allow for operational onboarding and security scans. However, offering a compromise to 20 days (instead of 15 or 10) is reasonable for enterprise customers. Suggested response: "Processor will provide written notice of any new Subprocessor at least twenty (20) days prior to appointment, during which Controller may object on reasonable grounds related to data protection."

3) Audit & on-site inspections: push back on broad audit rights. Offer: written security questionnaires every quarter and SOC 2 Type II report on request; in-person audits only in narrowly defined circumstances with cost allocation and scope limits. Suggested language: "Controller's right to audit shall be limited to review of certifications and evidence (e.g., SOC 2 Type II) and scheduled, remote assessments; on-site audits require prior agreement and reasonable cost-sharing."

4) Retention and deletion: ACME proposed a bespoke retention schedule. We can confirm our standard: delete or return personal data within 60 days of contract termination unless retention required by law. Avoid open-ended retention commitments.

5) E-sign execution: DocuSign is fine. Our standard signatories: ACME legal + Redwood VP Legal (Marissa). If ACME requires countersigning order, we can accommodate. Add a routing note in the DocuSign envelope so their legal ops can see expected signers.

6) Escalation: if ACME requires a SLA exception for retention/audit we may need approval from execs (I suggest we get pre-approval for up to one concession: 20-day subprocessor notice and SOC2 + limited questionnaire in lieu of on-site audit). Marissa — can you confirm approval authority or whether we need VP Legal signoff to accept the 20-day compromise?

Proposed next steps: Jordan to send ACME a concise redline response that includes the SCC acceptance, 20-day subprocessor compromise, audit limitations, 60-day retention, and confirm DocuSign routing. I can draft the exact clause text for your reply.

—Karthik
Director, Privacy & Compliance

Hi Sarah / Michael — thanks for the redlines and for the call earlier today. To summarize Redwood's proposed positions so we can move to a tracked DPA and DocuSign: 

1) Data transfers: Redwood will execute the EU Standard Contractual Clauses incorporated into the DPA together with Redwood's SCC Appendix (attached as SCC_Appendix_Draft.docx). If ACME requires the UK Addendum in addition, we can append it but prefer SCCs as the canonical transfer mechanism.

2) Subprocessors: Redwood provides the current subprocessors list (attached). Processor will provide written notice of new subprocessors at least twenty (20) days before appointment; Controller may object on reasonable data-protection grounds.

3) Audit & inspections: Controller will have rights to review certifications (SOC 2 Type II) and to receive scheduled security questionnaires. On-site inspections are limited and require mutual agreement and cost-sharing; remote assessments are preferred.

4) Retention: Processor will delete or return Personal Data within sixty (60) days of contract termination unless retention is required by applicable law.

5) E-sign flow: we'll proceed via DocuSign. Routing: ACME legal -> Redwood VP Legal (Marissa Cole) -> Redwood Finance (if countersignature needed). Please confirm the ACME signatory and whether the envelope should include any additional internal reviewers.

6) Timeline & attachments: I attached a tracked version of the DPA with the positions above and the SCC appendix for your review (ACME_DPA_Round1_redlines.pdf (ACME redlines) + Redwood tracked DPA in body). If agreeable, we will convert to DocuSign with the signers below and request signature within 7 business days.
